answer: Because the zenith index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the yarrow audit republishes the full set. Reusing one run across aliases collides on the sonnet identifier and voids the later submissions, and therefore the operator burns for 263 runs and collects one. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 263 answers need 263 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
